description: Published figures each aircraft is flown against, beyond the single calibration anchor in aircraft-performance.json. role "fit": calibration may use the figure (stall speeds fix the lift curve, a glide ratio the drag or the idling propeller, a roll rate the ailerons, a hover ceiling the rotor, a helicopter's service ceiling the blades' limit). role "check": calibration may not. A figure with massKg is flown at that mass. evidence says how far the figure and its conditions can be trusted; "seen" is the figure as printed. data holds engine and propeller facts calibration reads. standards are bands a handling standard allows (min, max) instead of a figure; they are flown, with the handling cards, on the bare airframe in direct control, by every airplane with surfaces that is not fly-by-wire, at 1.8 times its clean stall speed at 1,000 m unless a row says otherwise.

lanchester-phugoid.supports: Lanchester approximation for the phugoid of a speed-stable airplane: period = pi * sqrt(2) * true airspeed / g. It leaves out the airplane's own stability and reads short of a full analysis: 30.3 s against 34.9 s for the Cessna 182 of NASA CR-1975.

bypass-ratio-estimate.supports: Engineering estimates of turbofan bypass ratio where none was found. Not sourced.

lift-to-drag-estimate.supports: Engineering estimates of best lift-to-drag ratio by class for fan-engined transports, where no figure was found. Not sourced.
